question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

CONSPICUOUS
solution:
The correct answer is: Evident 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Conspicuous means very noticeable or attracting attention, often in a way that is not wanted.(विशिष्ट)

 
 
• Example - *There were a number of **conspicuous **changes to the building.*
 
 
 
• *​*Marked option Evident means the presence of visible signs that lead one to a definite conclusion.(प्रत्यक्ष)
 
 
• Example - *It was **evident **that the damage was very serious.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Conspicuous' and 'Evident' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Concealed means to prevent something/somebody from being seen or discovered.(गुप्त)
 
• Vague means not clearly stated, described, or explained, or not clearly seen or felt.(अस्पष्ट)
 
• Obscure means to make something difficult to see or understand.(अस्पष्ट)
